title: Renames the Reserve Release reason enum value
summary: For Reserve Releases, renames the bulk_hold_expiry value to hold_expired for the reason property. This property describes why funds were released. If your code matches on the bulk_hold_expiry value, you must update it to use hold_expired instead.

migrationNotes.text: Update your integration to handle hold_expired instead of bulk_hold_expiry when checking the reason property on Reserve Release objects.
